::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests citations and cross-references in the viewer**. A
caption is copied from the page, so whatever Quarto renders there comes
through. A description is rendered with the page too, in a hidden block
the viewer copies, so its citations resolve, its cross-references get
numbers, and a work cited only in a description is still listed under
References. Quarto's own lightbox shows a citation in a caption as raw
`[@key]` ([quarto-cli#10709](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/10709)).

Cases 1–5 have the `expect-references` attribute: the viewer must show
at least one citation or cross-reference, none unresolved, and each must
link to something on this page. Cases 6 and 7 test the per-cell `caption`
and `description` options (`expect-caption`).
:::

The cases below draw with this helper:

```{r}
wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  col <- hcl.colors(4, "Dark 3")[k]
  plot(x, sin(k * x), type = "n", main = paste("Wave", k), xlab = "x", ylab = "sin(kx)")
  polygon(c(x, rev(x)), c(sin(k * x), rep(0, length(x))), col = adjustcolor(col, 0.35), border = NA)
  lines(x, sin(k * x), lwd = 2, col = col)
}
```

## 1. Citation in a caption {#c1 expect-references=""}

The case from quarto-cli#10709.

## 2. Citation only in a description {#c2 expect-references=""}

Tufte is cited nowhere else on the page, but is listed under References.

![Edgartown Light](../../images/mv-2.jpg){.panzoom description="Show the data [@tufte2001, p. 13]."}

## 3. Cross-reference in a description {#c3 expect-references=""}

![Aquinnah](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom description="Compare with @fig-pressure, and see [Section 1](#c1)."}

## 4. Cell description with citation and math {#c4 expect-references=""}

```{r}
#| label: fig-pressure
#| fig-cap: "Vapor pressure of mercury [@fenner2012]."
#| panzoom:
#|   description: "Rises roughly as $p \\propto e^{-1/T}$ [@tufte2001]."

plot(pressure)
```

## 5. Gallery with a reference in each description {#c5 expect-references=""}

![Gingerbread](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom group="refs" description="As in @fig-pressure."}

![Sailboat](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom group="refs" description="As in @fenner2012."}

## 6. `caption: false` {#c6 expect-open="panzoom" expect-caption="none"}

The figure has a caption on the page, but not in the viewer.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   caption: false
#| fig-cap: "This caption stays on the page."

wave(k = 2)
```

## 7. `description` cell option {#c7 expect-open="panzoom"}

The description is Markdown, with math, shown under the caption.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: "A sine wave, $y = \\sin(kx)$, **k = 2**."
#| fig-cap: "With a description."

wave(k = 2)
```
